<?php
class VoidReturnGet {
    public function __get($incoming): void {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "bare") { return; }
    }
}
$receiver = new VoidReturnGet;
$selector = "fall";
echo $receiver->bare === null ? "BARE;" : "BAD_BARE;";
echo $receiver->$selector === null ? "FALL;" : "BAD_FALL;";
$receiver->drop;
echo "DROP;";
echo $selector === "fall" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class NeverReturnGet {
    public function __get(string $incoming): never {
        echo $incoming, ":";
    }
}
$receiver = new NeverReturnGet;
$selector = "bad";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $receiver->$selector === null; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "bad" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class ThrowNeverReturnGet {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): never {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        throw new Exception("never");
    }
}
$receiver = new ThrowNeverReturnGet;
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $receiver->bad === null; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class ExitNeverReturnGet {
    public function __get($incoming): never {
        echo $incoming, ":EXIT;";
        exit(13);
    }
}
$receiver = new ExitNeverReturnGet;
$selector = "go";
$receiver->$selector;
echo "BAD_AFTER;";
